baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence فَتَنَّا ... فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ... صَدَقُوا ... الْكَاذِبِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Testing supplies an assay that separates good from bad; the repeated knowledge clause is read through disclosure and marking, while truth supplies solidity. The ordeal therefore produces an inspectable distinction rather than merely adding information.

activation_trace.role: Testing metal or a person supplies the discriminating assay that exposes quality.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic emergence named by both emphatic knowledge clauses.
A distinguishing mark makes the assay result classifiable rather than merely inward.
Solidity and straightness give truth a material quality able to survive assay.
Contrariety to truth supplies the rejected class separated by the assay.

changed_reading.before: Earlier people were subjected to hardship, after which truthful and lying statements were identified.
changed_reading.after: The ordeal assays claims until solid truth and falsehood become distinguishable in events; the knowledge clauses name manifested separation, not an information deficit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The perfect verb صَدَقُوا is opposed to the agent noun الْكَاذِبِينَ and enclosed by repeated لَيَعْلَمَنَّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deflecting-pressure branch of testing meets truth as fulfillment in action and lying as a charge that fails to carry through. The two classes are therefore trajectories under pressure, not only verbal labels.

activation_trace.role: Deflection from an intended course supplies the pressure against which direction is tested.
Fulfilling a promise or claim in action turns truth into completed performance.
A charge that falters supplies the contrasting image of declared motion not carried through.

changed_reading.before: Truthful and liar are fixed labels attached to what people say.
changed_reading.after: Truth is a commitment that keeps its direction and fulfills itself under deflecting pressure; lying includes a declared trajectory that fails in performance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal مِن قَبْلِهِمْ precedes a future emphatic distinction after فَتَنَّا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Testing can comprise two conditions of life, priorness extends the frame historically, truth supplies stable completion, and a lie can name what was expected to continue but ran dry. The criterion becomes durability across altered conditions.

activation_trace.role: The two colors or conditions of life supply a changing environment rather than one pressure point.
Temporal precedence stretches the assay across earlier cohorts and later disclosure.
Completion and stability supply the continuity criterion for truth.
Milk that ceases despite expected duration supplies an exploratory image of non-durable display.

changed_reading.before: A single adverse moment exposes a lie.
changed_reading.after: Historically repeated testing compares conduct across bitter and sweet conditions: truth remains stable, while a lying display may be what seemed durable but ran dry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening claim of belief is not left in its stated condition, and the later promise to carry others' errors is negated and called a lie. Trial becomes a load test that joins utterance to the burden its speaker can actually bear.

activation_trace.role: Truth as fulfilled promise anchors the shift from statement to performed commitment.
Lying in word or deed anchors the failed side of the load test.
Being left in the same condition supplies the untested state that the ayah explicitly refuses.
Vocalized speech supplies the declared claim placed before testing.
Heart-settling assent supplies the content claimed by the speakers.
The paired promise to bear and denial of bearing faults makes claimed responsibility a literal load test.
The explicit liar verdict identifies the failed carrying promise as false in word and deed.

structural_cues: 29:2 orders saying 'we believe' before the negated expectation that speakers be left untested.
29:12 negates the promised carriers, and 29:13 returns burdens and added burdens to the speakers themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spoken assent, refusal to leave it untested, and a burden-bearing promise that fails; I infer that ordeal tests whether speech bears its own enacted weight. The live alternative is that 29:12 condemns only that specific misleading guarantee rather than defining every instance of sidq.

changed_reading.before: Testing checks whether a profession of belief is factually sincere.
changed_reading.after: Testing places a profession under load: the truthful claim carries through in its speaker's own action, whereas a lie offers or projects a burden-bearing capacity it does not possess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fire branch latent in فَتَنَّا is enacted when a prior community orders burning, rescue interrupts the intended consumption, and the episode is called signs. The assay identifies through a differential outcome that becomes markable evidence.

activation_trace.role: Burning and fire-blackening supply the latent material assay image.
The distinguishing-mark branch makes the fire outcome evidentiary.
Material solidity supplies what is tested without equating truth with physical indestructibility.
Flame and fire literalize the burning branch of the focus test.
Rescue by separation supplies the differential outcome of the attempted burn.
The blazing fire names the medium in which the prior test is enacted.
The visible sign turns survival and reversal into a resolvable mark.

structural_cues: 29:24 sequences 'kill him or burn him,' rescue from the fire, and then the statement that signs are in that event.
The focus places prior peoples before the resultative ف of the doubled knowledge clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fire branch, an actual burn order, rescue, and visible signs; I infer that this prior episode embodies the focus assay and that rescue is its distinguishing output. The alternative is that it is only one example of prior affliction and does not specify how the focus knowledge clause works.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only an etymological metaphor for generic testing.
changed_reading.after: A prior attempted burning enacts the assay image: the test does not simply consume its object but yields a differentiated survival-event that functions as a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The compressed phrase 'those before them' opens into prolonged residence, then rescue by separation in a vessel that cuts the water's surface, and finally a visible sign. Truth is tested over duration and resolved by a separating outcome, not by an immediate snapshot.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence anchors the earlier cohort and permits a long assay horizon.
Completion and stability make persistence, rather than momentary speech, diagnostic.
A distinguishing mark supplies the status of the final preserved sign.
Remaining in place supplies an explicitly prolonged interval of exposure.
Rescue by separation supplies the sorting outcome after duration.
The ship cutting the face of the water supplies a concrete separating carrier.
The resulting visible sign makes the long process legible after the fact.

structural_cues: 29:14 quantifies the stay as one thousand years less fifty, then introduces the flood.
29:15 immediately follows rescue and the ship with its conversion into a sign for the worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies long residence, flood, separated rescue, and a sign; I infer that the sequence expands the focus test into endurance plus final sorting. The alternative is that the sequence demonstrates historical precedent without identifying the rescued party with the focus category of the truthful.

changed_reading.before: Testing produces an immediate binary reading of a person.
changed_reading.after: The prior test can be a long-duration process whose distinction appears only when persistence, separation, and preservation have become a visible sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later sequence presents beautified deeds, active diversion from the path, and retained insight together. This activates فتن as deflection: the test asks whether cognition governs direction when error has been made attractive.

activation_trace.role: Deviation and enticement away from the intended course supply the testing mechanism.
Knowledge as disclosure is revised from mere possession of insight to insight proven in direction.
Making something appear good supplies the attractive pressure applied to judgment.
Crooked opposition supplies the agentive force aligning adornment with deviation.
Turning aside supplies the actual directional failure produced by the adornment.
Inner sight supplies the paradox that cognition can coexist with diverted conduct.

structural_cues: 29:38 orders the clauses as adornment of deeds, diversion from the path, and then 'they were discerning.'
The focus contrasts صَدَقُوا as performed truth with a noun naming the liars.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautification, diversion, and insight in one sequence; I infer that adorned pressure tests whether insight remains directive rather than merely present. The alternative is that مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ denotes worldly shrewdness, so no paradox with moral ignorance is intended.

changed_reading.before: Testing reveals which people lack knowledge and therefore lie.
changed_reading.after: Testing can expose a deeper split: people may retain insight while attractive distortion reroutes their action, so truth is fidelity of direction under epistemic pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Danger at sea produces exclusive, purified allegiance; rescue onto land is followed by sudden association. The two-condition branch of testing becomes a before-and-after durability assay, and the lie is the display whose expected continuity vanishes with relief.

activation_trace.role: Two conditions of life supply the pressure and relief phases of one test.
Completion and stability make cross-condition continuity the truth criterion.
Expected continuity that runs dry supplies an exploratory but exact image for sincerity that expires after rescue.
Undertaking and carrying a perilous matter supplies entry into the pressured phase.
The vessel moving in water supplies the unstable setting of the first condition.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the apparently pure allegiance under danger.
Assent and entrusting supply the allegiance displayed in the pressured phase.
Rescue by separation supplies the hinge from danger to relief.
Association after rescue supplies the reversal that exposes failed continuity.

structural_cues: 29:65 uses فَلَمَّا for rescue to land and then إِذَا for the abrupt return to association.
The focus repeats future emphatic knowledge after an earlier completed test, allowing conduct across phases to determine the distinction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies danger, exclusive allegiance, rescue, and abrupt association; I infer that the change of condition is the assay and continuity is its criterion. The alternative is narrower: the sequence may diagnose association specifically without redefining all focus lying as unstable sincerity.

changed_reading.before: A liar is simply insincere at the moment of professing allegiance.
changed_reading.after: A displayed allegiance may be locally sincere under danger yet fail the test because it does not survive relief; truth is durable across both conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated inability to outrun, human haste, an appointed limit, sudden arrival, and a later 'they will know' recast the doubled future knowledge in the focus as endpoint disclosure. Apparent position mid-course does not settle the truthful/liar distinction.

activation_trace.role: Temporal ordering supplies a course with precedent, present motion, and later closure.
The emphatic future disclosure supplies the endpoint at which the classes become resolved.
A wild runner that goes a distance and then stops supplies the exploratory image of a false trajectory judged only over its full course.
Escaping the pursuer supplies the mistaken hope that present lead can evade the result.
The repeated denial of outstripping confirms that apparent advance does not defeat closure.
Demanded acceleration supplies human pressure to force the verdict early.
The fixed temporal limit supplies the actual completion point.
Sudden arrival prevents observers from equating delay with escape.
The later 'they will know' echoes disclosure deferred until after present enjoyment.

structural_cues: The focus uses future emphatic لَيَعْلَمَنَّ twice after the completed فَتَنَّا.
29:4 and 29:39 repeat the inability to outstrip; 29:53 joins haste to an appointed term and surprise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies race, non-escape, deadline, surprise, and future knowing; I infer a finish-line model in which classification requires the full trajectory. The alternative is that these later timing cues concern punishment alone and do not control the epistemic force of 29:3.

changed_reading.before: The test yields a verdict at the first observable response.
changed_reading.after: The distinction closes over a full course at its appointed endpoint: an apparent lead can fail, and delayed disclosure is not failure to know.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs held in the source from which actions issue and a witness who states from knowledge expand the marking branch of عَلِمَ. The focus distinction becomes evidentiary and resolvable in signs, inner source, and testimony, not merely a private classification.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark anchors the focus knowledge clauses in evidentiary manifestation.
Agreement of speech, inward content, and reported reality supplies the evidentiary standard.
Appearance and disclosure make the signs overtly resolvable.
The source from which actions issue supplies an inward locus tied to outward conduct.
Knowledge carried with clear signs repeats the distinguishing-mark image outside the focus.
Testimony stated from knowledge supplies an accountable form of disclosure.
Knowing immediately after witness joins comprehensive cognition to evidentiary presence.

structural_cues: 29:48 denies prior recitation and writing by the right hand, making the counterfactual doubt of falsifiers an evidentiary issue; خ ط ط has no branch inventory and is used only here.
29:49 places clear signs in the breasts of those given knowledge, and 29:52 places witnessing immediately before knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-fabrication cues, clear signs in an inward locus, witness, and knowledge; I infer that the focus result is made evidentially manifest. The alternative is that these verses concern the book's credentials and divine witness without specifying the mechanism of testing in 29:3.

changed_reading.before: God privately sorts two inward types after testing.
changed_reading.after: Without reducing divine knowing to public evidence, the test makes the distinction witnessable through marks where inward source, enacted truth, and testimony can converge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Patience and reliance are followed at the surah's close by strenuous effort and promised guidance into paths. Trial therefore need not only screen pre-existing types; it can be the process in which truthful performance is stabilized and further direction opens.

activation_trace.role: Testing a person supplies the process whose function is revised from purely diagnostic to partly formative.
Truth fulfilled in action anchors formation in performance rather than an unobservable label.
Holding the self back from panic supplies sustained conduct within pressure.
Reliant entrusting supplies the orientation that accompanies endurance.
Exerting capacity under hardship supplies active truthful performance.
Gentle direction to path and truth supplies the new guidance that follows exertion.

structural_cues: 29:59 coordinates patience with reliance rather than presenting endurance as passive stasis.
29:69 closes with exertion in Us followed by emphatic guidance into Our paths and divine accompaniment of doers of good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endurance, reliance, exertion, and subsequent guidance; I infer a causal arrow in which tested action both reveals and helps stabilize truth. The live alternative is that guidance rewards an already settled truthful identity and does not form it.

changed_reading.before: Testing merely reveals which fixed type a person already is.
changed_reading.after: Testing can also form the disclosed trajectory: patient, reliant exertion enacts truth, and guidance opens as that enactment continues.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects the focus's garment-that-lies-by-appearance branch to a later house and patron analogy. It remains anchored in الْكَاذِبِينَ and in the focus contrast between solidity and lying, while 29:41 supplies an apparently sheltering support that is weakest. Downstream prose should present it only as a structural analogy, not as a lexical gloss of كاذبين or a claim that a spider's house is visually deceptive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الْكَاذِبِينَ through ك ذ ب B009, contrasted with صَدَقُوا through ص د ق B002.

activation_trace.role: A garment that misreports its condition supplies the image of a surface whose promise exceeds its structure.
Solidity supplies the opposing criterion of structural truth.
The explicit analogy authorizes a controlled cross-domain comparison.
Alliance and support supply what the chosen structure is expected to provide.
Shelter and dwelling supply the apparent protective function under test.
Weak force and slack resolve the load test against the apparent shelter.

changed_reading.before: A liar is only a person who utters a proposition contrary to fact.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, lying can be structural misrepresentation: a support presents the function of shelter but fails when reliance applies load, whereas truth is load-bearing congruence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reverses the assay: those tested in the focus later taste what they themselves did. It remains anchored in فَتَنَّا as testing and in the context branch where tasting means experiencing or trying, with عمل supplying the returned product. Downstream prose should mark this as a reciprocal mechanism suggested by sequence, not equate فتنة and ذوق lexically or claim that every test is punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَتَنَّا as assay in relation to the later imperative ذُوقُوا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ.

activation_trace.role: The assay of the person supplies the initial direction of testing.
Disclosure supplies the result produced by the initial assay.
Experiencing and trying supplies the reversed direction in which the actor becomes taster.
Intentional deed supplies the product returned for experiential verification.

changed_reading.before: People are passive objects on whom a test operates until their type is known.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the assay is reciprocal: tested action becomes an output returned to its maker as something experienced, making classification self-involving rather than merely observed.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from adversity as information gathering to an assay that makes hidden quality distinguishable and markable.
29:2 and 29:12 turn declared belief into a load-bearing claim whose promised carrying can fail in action.
29:24 literalizes the fire branch, while 29:65 makes sea-to-land reversal an especially sharp test of cross-condition durability.
29:38 shows that possessed insight can still be diverted, so truth is directional fidelity under adorned pressure.
29:69 makes testing partly formative: patient exertion is followed by opened guidance, not only sorting.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted focus branch images into mechanisms: fire became an event and sign, claims became loads, long history became delayed separation, changing conditions exposed expiring sincerity, and even shelter and tasting supplied contained structural reversals.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether لَيَعْلَمَنَّ is best rendered as enacted manifestation, witnessable distinction, or simply certain divine knowing.
How far the non-durability branches of ك ذ ب can govern the surface noun الْكَاذِبِينَ rather than remain analogical.
Whether the long-residence, scriptural-evidence, and guidance sequences directly instantiate the focus test or only run parallel to it.
The shelter and reciprocal-tasting readings remain branch-distant and should not displace the stronger assay, performance, and continuity models.
